name: @mono-agent/session-web
description: Discovers local mono-agent instances and serves a read-only web PWA that visualises their runs live — aggregating recorded-run history with operator-adapter live sub-run streams.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:webapp && pnpm run build:server
scripts.build:webapp: pnpm --dir webapp install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir webapp run build
scripts.test: vitest run --passWithNoTests src/__tests__ && pnpm --dir webapp run test
